channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Davi Alcolumbre e Hugo Motta se reúnem com Kassio no TSE
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre and Hugo Motta met with Minister Kassio at the TSE to discuss electoral issues and the judicialization of candidates. The meeting aims to align positions between the executive and judicial powers in the context of the 2026 elections. The meeting takes place amid debates on electoral rules and transparency.

item.title: A que horas sai o resultado da eleição? Veja a estimativa do presidente do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, stated that the election process is proceeding normally and predicted that the final results will be announced at the usual time. He emphasized the transparency and efficiency of the electoral process.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro vota em Brasília ao lado de Celina Leão
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro cast her vote in Brasília alongside Celina Leão and Bia Kicis, expressing support for the governor and candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. She emphasized expectations of victory to prevent what she called a setback, and said she will follow the vote count at home with Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Ao vivo: Nunes Marques, Motta e Alcolumbre falam sobre o 2º turno
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques presents partial results of the second round with 158.7 million eligible voters. The presidential race is between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The court verified systems after a first-round interruption.

item.title: Alcolumbre e Motta se reúnem com Nunes Marques no TSE
item.description: The presidents of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), and the Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), met with the president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, in Brasília, to monitor the voting and counting of the 2nd round of elections. The meeting took place at the headquarters of the Electoral Court and included all three at the Elections Disclosure Center.

item.title: Apoiadores de Flávio convocam ato em Brasília após a votação
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) organized a rally in Brasília following the closure of the polls, expected to start at 7 PM at the Republic Museum. The demonstration, organized by the Influenciadores do Brasil movement and Senator Bia Kicis (PL-DF), is expected to last until 11 PM. Authorities are monitoring the event in the federal capital.

item.title: TRE determina prisão de secretário de Salvador por retenção de ônibus em dia de eleição
item.description: The Bahia Electoral Court ordered the arrest of Salvador's Mobility Secretary Pablo Souza for reducing bus services during the election's second round, hindering voter access to polling stations. The ruling imposes a R$1 million hourly fine on the city and transport companies, along with police monitoring using drones. The case was filed by a coalition of parties (PT, PCdoB, PV) accusing the administration of Bruno Reis (União Brasil) of undermining the election.

item.title: Voto no exterior: veja os resultados por país e a apuração de Lula x Flávio no 2º turno das eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 presidential runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro leads abroad, especially in Japan and UAE, while Lula wins in countries like Australia and New Zealand. Partial results show 1 million eligible Brazilian voters overseas across 186 cities. Official counting will be released starting at 5 PM Brasília time.

item.title: Sete cidades escolhem prefeitos e vices em eleições suplementares
item.description: Seven Brazilian cities hold supplementary elections to elect mayors and deputy mayors following irregularities identified by the Electoral Justice. Winners will assume office until December 31, 2028. The votes were scheduled after candidate slates were annulled for economic power abuse and vote buying, according to the TSE.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha, lobista Roberta Luchsinger declara voto em Flávio
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist investigated for influence peddling in the Lula government, declared her vote for Flávio Bolsonaro, breaking with the PT leader after being criticized by the president. She justified her choice by arguing that Brazil needs a new cycle and that Lula no longer has the conditions to face the country's challenges.

item.title: Como votar nas Eleições 2026 no 2º turno: veja ordem de votação
item.description: In the 2026 runoff elections, Brazilians vote for president or governor (in 6 states). Requires ID, 8am-5pm voting hours. Live results and ideological affinity tests are available on GLOBO.

item.title: Sistema eleitoral brasileiro ‘é muito sólido e muito claro', diz observador da OEA após acompanhar votação
item.description: José Miguel Insulza, head of the OAS electoral observation mission in Brazil, stated that the Brazilian electoral system is solid and clear, emphasizing the security of the process and the absence of issues so far. He praised the mechanisms for verifying the integrity of the voting machines and confirmed that the mission did not identify foreign interference, recommending that the statements of the TSE be taken into account.

item.title: TSE alerta para informações falsas sobre eleitor que 'descobre que outra pessoa votou em seu lugar'
item.description: The TSE warns against false messages that mislead voters who are told someone else already voted in their place. If such a situation occurs, the voting machine officer must report it to the electoral judge, and all events should be recorded in the minutes. The court also emphasizes that photographing the vote booklet is not allowed.

item.title: Até que horas pode votar nas Eleições 2026? Veja horário de encerramento da votação
item.description: Voting in the 2026 elections closes at 5 PM (Brasília time) nationwide, with local times adjusted by time zone. Voters in line at closing time can still cast their ballots. Each state follows regional hours, such as Acre (6 AM–3 PM) and Fernando de Noronha (9 AM–6 PM).

item.title: Justiça determina prisão de secretário por redução de ônibus na BA
item.description: Brazil's electoral court ordered the arrest of Pablo Souza, Salvador's mobility secretary, for reducing the bus fleet during the second round of elections, imposing a $1 million per hour fine for non-compliance. The ruling responded to a lawsuit filed by the Brazil of Hope Federation against Mayor Bruno Reis and transporters, alleging failures in public transport during the vote. A similar measure was taken in São Paulo, where Lula's campaign questioned bus availability for voters.

item.title: Jão, Ludmilla, Luísa Sonza, Simaria: cantores votam no 2º turno das eleições de 2026; FOTOS
item.description: Brazilian music artists such as Jão, Ludmilla, Luísa Sonza, and Simaria went to vote in the second round of the 2026 elections, choosing between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Gubernatorial races are also contested in five states.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 80,81% dos votos em Israel; Lula, 95,60% na Palestina
item.description: In Israel, Flávio Bolsonaro secured 80.81% of the vote (699), while Lula received 19.19% (166). In Palestine, Lula won 95.6% (1,110 votes) to Flávio's 4.4% (46). The October 25 vote is the 2026 election runoff.

item.title: 'Estamos confiantes', diz Alckmin ao votar em São Paulo
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin expressed confidence in Lula's reelection after voting in São Paulo, highlighting street support and advocacy for democracy. He refrained from judging the opposing campaign and emphasized the historical significance of the election.

item.title: Cleitinho vota e faz eleitores de Lula e de Flávio se abraçarem
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo, governor-elect of Minas Gerais (Republicanos), urged voters supporting Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to hug before voting, emphasizing democracy and dialogue. He highlighted that uniting forces reflects respect for political differences.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Flávio diz que chegou a 'hora da mudança'; Lula fala que povo é 'exército da democracia'; acompanhe
item.description: The 2026 elections reach the runoff with debates highlighting remote voting access, transportation logistics, and social mobilization. Flávio holds 51% of valid votes against Lula's 49% in the latest survey. Both emphasize democracy and the people as central themes of the race.

item.title: TRE da Bahia manda prender secretário de mobilidade de Salvador
item.description: The president of the Bahia Electoral Court ordered the arrest of the mobility secretary in Salvador after buses were blocked from leaving due to stickers with Lula's voting number, causing transportation difficulties for voters during the 2026 election runoff.

item.title: Mais de 2 milhões de eleitores justificam ausência no segundo turno até as 12h, diz TSE
item.description: The TSE recorded 2,644,306 absentee notifications for the 2026 electoral runoff by noon on Sunday (25). Voters used the e-Title app to justify not attending the polls. Voting takes place nationwide.

item.title: Ministro do STF, Gilmar Mendes não votará no 2º turno por questões médicas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes did not vote in the second round of elections due to medical issues, avoiding travel from his residence in Brasília to his polling station in Diamantino (MT), as voting is optional for those over 70.

item.title: Trump diz que não quer comentar sobre endosso, mas diz que está monitorando eleições no Brasil
item.description: Donald Trump stated he is monitoring the 2026 Brazilian elections but declined to comment on endorsing candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro or Lula. The former U.S. president avoided taking a stance, only noting he is following the electoral process.

item.title: A que horas sai o resultado do 2º turno das eleições 2026 entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro?
item.description: The results of the 2026 presidential runoff will be announced between 8:30 PM and 9:00 PM after polls close at 5:00 PM. The candidates are Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with vote counting beginning after polls close.

item.title: Toffoli: “Que o próximo governante possa trazer paz para a nação”
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli, after voting on Sunday in Brasília, wore a white shirt to symbolically ask the next president to bring peace to the nation, refraining from further comments on candidates or parties.

item.title: TSE registra 2,6 milhões de justificativas de ausência pelo e-título até o meio-dia
item.description: The TSE recorded 2.644 million absence justifications via the e-Title app by noon, while 2.322 million electronic titles were issued. Voting is mandatory for citizens aged 18 to 70, and failure to vote without justification results in fines and civil consequences such as passport suspension and restrictions on access to benefits and public jobs.

item.title: O horário previsto por Nunes Marques para o resultado das eleições
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, estimated that the 2026 election results will be announced between 8:30 PM and 9:00 PM, following historical patterns. He emphasized the efficiency of the Electoral Justice and noted the participation of over 158 million voters in the runoff.

item.title: Eleições 2026: acompanhe a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno e a votação no Brasil e no exterior
item.description: Polls are open from 8am to 5pm this Sunday, October 25, for the runoff election between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro. BBC News Brasil will provide live coverage with vote counting starting at 4:30pm.

item.title: Trump tem que ficar de fora da política do Brasil, diz New York Times
item.description: The New York Times published an editorial stating that President Donald Trump should stay out of Brazil's politics during the presidential election runoff. The publication emphasized the importance of national autonomy in elections.

item.title: Haddad vota em SP e destaca 'clima excelente' nas ruas
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) voted in São Paulo and highlighted an 'excellent atmosphere' on the streets, emphasizing Lula's legacy for the runoff election. Defeated for São Paulo governor, he stressed the continuation of progressive policies.

item.title: Lula chega para votar em São Bernardo (SP)
item.description: Lula arrived at the polling station in São Bernardo do Campo, SP, to cast his vote in the 2026 municipal election, emphasizing his commitment to civic participation.

item.title: Segundo turno: eleitores poderão enfrentar temporal e ventos de até 100 km/hora, alerta INMET
item.description: The 2026 runoff election takes place this Sunday, with voters choosing between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for president, and in some states, governor. The INMET warns of adverse weather conditions including winds up to 100 km/h and heavy rains that may impact the electoral process.

item.title: Eventual vitória de Flávio consolidaria 'onda azul' da direita, diz jornal La Nación
item.description: Argentine newspaper La Nación claims that a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election would consolidate a 'blue wave' of right-wing governments in Latin America. The article highlights the growing influence of conservative leaders in the region.

item.title: Eleições 2026: brasileiros reclamam de filas para votar no exterior
item.description: Brazilian voters abroad face long lines and logistical challenges while casting ballots in the 2026 elections, particularly in cities like Paris, Lisbon, and Dublin. Voting began in New Zealand and now spans 134 countries, with approximately 918,876 eligible voters. Overseas Brazilians can only vote for president and vice-president.

item.title: Famosos votam no 2º turno das eleições de 2026; FOTOS
item.description: Citizens and public figures visited the polls in the 2026 runoff election, contested between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Voting takes place nationwide, with gubernatorial races in five states. Entertainment personalities were spotted at their respective polling stations.

item.title: Antes de votar, Lula agradece eleitores e alfineta Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: President Lula thanked voters for their support and cast his ballot in São Bernardo do Campo. Before voting, he criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him a liar and saying the people won't elect a liar. Lula received 45% of valid votes in the first round, behind Flávio.

item.title: Guia das Eleições 2026: ônibus e metrô de graça para votar e tudo o que você precisa saber no 2º turno
item.description: In the 2026 runoff election, public transportation (buses, metro, trains, ferries) will be free nationwide per a Supreme Court ruling. Voting takes place Sunday, October 25, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (Brasília time), with each city managing the free service schedule. Cutting transport on election day is an electoral offense.

item.title: Cantora lamenta não poder votar e recebe o carinho da torcida lulista
item.description: Singer Marina Sena publicly regretted being unable to vote in the 2026 runoff election, despite having campaigned for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Her statement sparked mixed reactions, including criticism from Lula supporters for not exercising her right to vote. The post gained significant attention on social media, drawing responses from both supporters and opponents.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vence Lula no Japão no 2º turno das eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) defeated Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in Japan during the second round of the 2026 presidential elections, securing 80.08% of the valid votes. The election was held earlier due to the time zone difference, allowing Brazilian residents to vote before polls opened in Brazil. Japan ranks as the third-largest electoral college for Brazilians abroad.

item.title: Moraes vota e diz que sistema eleitoral do Brasil é o melhor do mundo
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes voted and praised the Brazilian electoral system as the best in the world. PoderData poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva tied in the second round, with 51% and 49% of valid votes respectively.

item.title: Restaurante fecha no 2º turno após denúncia de impedir equipe de votar
item.description: The Estrela do Sul restaurant in Brasília's North Wing decided to close on Election Day following allegations of preventing employees from voting in the first round. The Labor Public Ministry intervened to ensure workers' voting rights, recommending flexible work schedules. Management stated the closure aims to prevent voting difficulties while respecting employees' freedom of conscience.

item.title: Lula chega a colégio em São Bernardo do Campo para votar no 2º turno
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) voted in the second round of the 2026 elections in São Bernardo do Campo, accompanied by his wife Janja, Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, and former minister Fernando Haddad. After voting, Lula went to his hotel on Paulista Avenue to follow the vote count, facing a disadvantage in São Paulo state against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Davi Alcolumbre vota no Amapá e faz chamado à paz e ao respeito
item.description: The President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, voted in Macapá (AP) and emphasized the importance of freedom of choice, peace, and respect on election day. After voting, he headed to Brasília and, at noon, will visit the TSE alongside the President of the Chamber, Hugo Motta.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Flávio e Lula após últimos números da semana
item.description: Recent polls show a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the runoff, with variations between surveys. The gap between candidates ranges from 0.2 percentage points (Futura) to four points (Gerp), keeping the race balanced.

item.title: Como saber se seu local de votação mudou no 2º turno
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court advises voters to confirm their polling place before the second round, as addresses may change. The data is updated four times daily and can vary until Sunday, so it is important to use only official channels.

item.title: Votos do Nordeste demoram mais para chegar ao TSE? Tudo para acompanhar a apuração
item.description: Votes from the Northeast and North take longer to be counted by the TSE, affecting the electoral vote count. In 2014, this delay nearly favored Aécio Neves before Dilma Rousseff reversed the outcome.

item.title: Derrite vota e cita redução da maioridade penal como prioridade
item.description: Elected senator Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) voted in São Paulo and emphasized the reduction of the criminal age of majority as a congressional priority in 2027, reaffirming his support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential race and projecting a widening vote margin in the second round.

item.title: Elecciones en Brasil, en vivo | Casi 160 millones de brasileños definen el futuro del país entre Lula y Bolsonaro
item.description: Around 160 million Brazilian voters are set to decide the next president in a runoff between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and ultrarightist Flávio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro convicted of attempting a coup. Flávio, who voted early in Rio de Janeiro, emphasized calls for change, stating Brazil can no longer endure the status quo.

item.title: Eleição começa com chuva e vento em Berlim; Joanna Maranhão se emociona ao falar de Lula
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections continue with the runoff vote in Berlin, where citizens cast their ballots under rain and 8°C cold. Joanna Maranhão, presidential candidate, becomes emotional when speaking about Lula, as shorter lines form outside the Brazilian Embassy. Adverse weather and emotional speeches underscore the tense electoral atmosphere in this decisive phase.
